name: p2p-gostop
description: 오프라인 P2P 2인 맞고 (Android 호스트 + iPhone Safari 게스트)

scripts.lint: npm run lint:oxc && npm run lint -w packages/web
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --type-aware --fix && oxfmt && npm run lint:fix -w packages/web
scripts.format:file: sh -c 'case "$0" in packages/web/*) exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --log-level warn --ignore-path packages/web/.prettierignore "$0" ;; *) exec oxfmt --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$0" ;; esac'
